name: feishin
title: Feishin
description: Control Feishin music player via its remote control server
author: pacuftw

preferences.name: host
preferences.title: Host
preferences.description: Feishin server hostname or IP address

preferences.name: port
preferences.title: Port
preferences.description: Remote control server port (set in Feishin Settings > Remote Control)

preferences.name: username
preferences.title: Username
preferences.description: Remote control username (leave empty if not configured)

preferences.name: password
preferences.title: Password
preferences.description: Remote control password (leave empty if not configured)

preferences.name: navidromeUrl
preferences.title: Navidrome URL
preferences.description: Your Navidrome server URL. (Only needed for cover art)

preferences.name: navidromeUsername
preferences.title: Navidrome Username
preferences.description: Navidrome account username (Only needed for cover art)

preferences.name: navidromePassword
preferences.title: Navidrome Password
preferences.description: Navidrome account password (Only needed for cover art)

commands.name: now-playing
commands.title: Now Playing
commands.description: Show currently playing song with full playback controls

commands.name: cycle-repeat
commands.title: Cycle Repeat Mode
commands.description: Cycle through repeat modes: off, all, one

commands.name: favorite
commands.title: Toggle Favorite
commands.description: Toggle favorite status for the current song

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
